A long quest in the Shattered Isles, south of Liberty Bay: you help the rebel pirates of {wiki:Meriana|Meriana} (Sabrehaven) against the raiding pirates of {wiki:Nargor|Nargor}. Along the way you unlock Goroma, the Goroma volcano (lair of {creature:Morgaroth}), Ramoa, Talahu, Malada, Kharos (Ferumbras Citadel), the Laguna Islands and Nargor. At the end you receive a {item:Model Ship}, the {wiki:Pirate Outfits|Pirate Outfits} and the achievement **Matchmaker**.

You find yourself in the middle of a battle between Meriana's peaceful freedom fighters and the plundering hordes of Nargor. Your mission is to defeat the Nargor pirates and help the Meriana pirates bring peace to Liberty Bay. Careful! There is a storm on the route between Thais and Liberty Bay that can catch the ship and interrupt the journey.

The quest is divided into several accesses. The logical order is: Goroma → Meriana → Goroma volcano → Ramoa → Talahu → Malada → Kharos, and Nargor (after Meriana).
Bring a {item:Shovel} to Goroma: the 2 underground areas of Island Trolls are the easiest way to gather the wood.
Gather the 5 {item:Pirate Voodoo Doll|Pirate Voodoo Dolls} while crossing the Goroma volcano: you save a trip.
The {spell:Invisible} spell or a {item:Stealth Ring} makes crossing the volcano much easier: {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} can't see invisible.
For the Nargor part, **one** Pirate Set is enough for the whole team.
This map shows how all the islands and accesses of this quest connect. Come back to it whenever you feel lost.
Roadmap of all parts of the Shattered Isles Quest
You need level 20. {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship is wrecked in a storm on the way to Thais and you get stranded on Goroma.

At the **Liberty Bay** harbour, talk to captain {npc:Jack Fate} and ask for passage to Thais (180 gold). He warns you about the tropical storm: confirm with {key:yes}. Sooner or later the ship is wrecked and you end up on **Goroma**. If you reach Thais without being wrecked, repeat the trip.

On Goroma, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} next to the wrecked ship. Say {key:hi}, {key:sail} and accept helping with {key:yes}. He needs **exactly 30 pieces of {item:Wood}** (no more, no less). Confirm again with {key:yes}.

Kill {creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls} until you have 30 {item:Wood}. The easiest way is to use the {item:Shovel} to enter the island's **2 underground areas** of Island Trolls. To leave each one, go back to the hole you came down through and climb up with the {item:Rope}.

Go back to {npc:Jack Fate} with the 30 pieces. Say {key:hi}, {key:sail} and {key:yes}. From now on he takes you from Liberty Bay to Goroma for 500 gp (ask for {key:passage} to Goroma). To return to Liberty Bay right away, say {key:passage} and {key:yes}.

You need 9 {item:Parcel|Parcels} (or {spell:Levitate}), a {item:Rake} (Venore, 20 gp), a {item:Love Poem} (Ab'Dendriel, 200 gp) and about 1,000 gp for trips. In the Liberty Bay tavern there is a notice on the wall: *"Missing ring! High reward! Contact Lady Eleonore in the Silverhand Manor!"*

Go to Silverhand Manor, on a small hill in the **north of Liberty Bay** (2 floors above ground level). Talk to {npc:Eleonore}: say {key:hi} and {key:ring}. A parrot stole her ring and took it to the mountains; you will need a {item:Rake}.
With the {item:Rake}, go straight **east** from Liberty Bay to the main entrance of the big fortress. Go up the ramp to enter.

Go to the **north** side of the fortress and look for a spot where you can use {spell:Levitate} (or {item:Parcel|Parcels}) to climb up. Keep climbing the mountain until you reach a floor with one or more {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}. There, head **east** until you find a tree with a parrot on top.
Shake the tree with the rake
Use the {item:Rake} on the tree to shake it. The parrot drops {item:Crystal Ring (Eleonore)|Eleonore's ring} (*"You see a crystal ring. [...] The initials E.S. are engraved on it."*). Pick it up.

Go back the same way to the fortress entrance: at the places where you went up with {spell:Levitate}, go down with Levitate (*exani hur "down*). From the main entrance of the fortress head **west** to Liberty Bay.
Go back to {npc:Eleonore} and say {key:ring} and {key:yes}. She gives you gold as a reward and asks if you want to run a small errand.
Answer {key:yes} twice to {npc:Eleonore}. She gives you **200 gold** to deliver to the herbalist {npc:Charlotta}.
Don't spend the 200 gold: it is for delivering.
Go to the far **southwest** of Liberty Bay and talk to {npc:Charlotta}. Say {key:hi}, {key:errand} (tell her about the gold) and {key:yes}. She gives you the secret password: **peg leg**.
Get the reward for the errand
Go back to {npc:Eleonore}. Say {key:hi} and {key:errand}: you receive 5 gold.

Still with {npc:Eleonore}, say {key:peg leg} and {key:yes}. She tells you she is in love with Captain Ray Striker, a freedom fighter, and has lost contact with him. She sends you to talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} and tell him **peg leg**.

Go to the small peninsula **southeast of the depot** in Liberty Bay and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}. Say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes}. He takes you to the rebel camp of **Sabrehaven** (Meriana) for 50 gold.
In Sabrehaven, {npc:Raymond Striker} is in a house in the **centre of the island**. Say {key:hi}, {key:Eleonore} and {key:mermaid}. You realise he is bewitched by a mermaid.
The mermaid {npc:Marina} is near the **north coast** of the island. Say {key:hi} and {key:Raymond Striker}. She confirms the spell and says she won't let him go, unless someone better comes along.

Explore the area **southwest** of Sabrehaven: the lonely djinn {npc:Ocelus} is at the top of a mountain (3 floors above ground level; to return to Sabrehaven, go down the mountain the same way). Say {key:hi}, {key:Eleonore}, {key:mermaid}, {key:date} and {key:yes}. He is in love with Marina, but is too shy to invite her.
Ocelus, at the top of the mountain
Ask Marina on a date (1st time)
Go back to {npc:Marina} and say {key:hi} and {key:date}. She refuses: a true djinn would be more poetic.
Go back to {npc:Ocelus} and say {key:mermaid}. He asks you for an elven love poem.

If you don't have it yet, go to **Ab'Dendriel** and buy a {item:Love Poem} (the item is called *Poem Scroll*) from {npc:Elvith} for 200 gp. Route: from Meriana go back to Liberty Bay with {npc:Sebastian} ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}), take {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 170 gp) and there {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to Ab'Dendriel ({key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}, 70 gp). To return: {npc:Captain Seagull} from Ab'Dendriel to Edron ({key:edron}), {npc:Captain Seahorse} to Liberty Bay ({key:liberty bay}) and {npc:Captain Waverider} to Meriana ({key:peg leg}).
Go back to {npc:Ocelus} and say {key:love poem} and {key:yes}. He casts a spell on you so that you recite the poem like a true elven poet.
Ask Marina on a date (2nd time)

Go to {npc:Marina} and say {key:hi} and {key:date}. She accepts the djinn, lets go of Raymond and lets you ride her sea turtles (look for them on the shores). You gain access to the **Laguna Islands** and the achievement **Matchmaker**.

To return to **Liberty Bay**, go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp). Whenever you need to go back to Meriana, use {npc:Captain Waverider} in Liberty Bay again ({key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}, 50 gp).
Go back to {npc:Eleonore} in Silverhand Manor and tell her about the errand ({key:errand}). You can also say {key:Ray Striker} and {key:mermaid}: she thanks you for freeing Ray from the spell.
6. The counterspell (access to the Goroma volcano)

You need level 35 and access to Goroma. After this mission you have access to the spawn location of {creature:Morgaroth}. Also bring a fresh {item:Dead Chicken}, {item:Dead Rat} and {item:Dead Black Sheep} (see tips below).

Go to **Goroma** with {npc:Jack Fate} at the Liberty Bay harbour ({key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes}, 500 gp); you land in the **east** of the island. From there, head **west** until you find a hole. Go down. You see an energy barrier and a corpse: open the corpse to get {item:Dragha's Spellbook}. To leave, climb up through the same hole with the {item:Rope} and go back to {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}) to return to Liberty Bay.
Hole on Goroma (corpse with the book)
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
The energy barrier and the corpse with the book

Go to **Meriana** (in Liberty Bay, with {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}) and talk to the shaman {npc:Chondur}, in the northeast of the island. Say {key:hi}, {key:spellbook}, {key:energy field}, {key:counterspell}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He asks for a fresh **Dead Chicken, Dead Rat and Dead Black Sheep, in that order**.

There are {creature:Rat|Rats} and {creature:Chicken|Chickens} on the island, near Chondur's house. The nearest {creature:Black Sheep} spawn is in the {wiki:Cult Cave|Cult Cave}. The corpses have to be **fresh**: the Dead Black Sheep reaches its first stage of decay in 5 minutes.
Since update 9.50 you cannot use summons: their corpses disappear when they die.

The {item:Dead Black Sheep} weighs 700 oz. If you do not have enough capacity: leave everything in the Liberty Bay depot, take the dead sheep to Meriana and drop it on the ground, go back to Liberty Bay to fetch your things, return to Meriana and drag the sheep to Chondur. A level 45 with haste does the trip in about 4 minutes.
Getting to the Black Sheep in the Cult Cave

The entrance to the {wiki:Cult Cave} is in Vandura, to the **northeast** of Liberty Bay: it is a hole hidden in the courtyard of one of the sheds, guarded by a {wiki:Jungle Maw|Jungle Maw}. Go down the hole; on the floor below, go up the ladder (*Up the Ladder*) to the ground floor of the cave, where the {creature:Black Sheep} are in a round room (D on the map), with a {creature:Witch}. To leave, go back the same way to the entrance hole (bring a {item:Rope}).
Cult Cave entrance (hole in the hut)
Cult Cave, floor -1 (where you land from the entrance hole)
Cult Cave, ground floor: the Black Sheep are in room D
In the cave there are {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}.
With the fresh {item:Dead Chicken}, say {key:counterspell} and {key:yes} to {npc:Chondur}.
With the fresh {item:Dead Rat}, say {key:counterspell} and {key:yes}.
Hand in the Dead Black Sheep
With the fresh {item:Dead Black Sheep}, say {key:counterspell} and {key:yes}. Chondur protects you and you can now cross the energy barrier in Goroma.
You can cross Goroma's energy barrier (volcano and Morgaroth's lair)
7. Access to Ramoa (island of the undead)

Ramoa is also known as the island of the undead or of the bonebeasts. In the north there is a {wiki:Teleportation Hub|Teleportation Hub} that connects the islands, but you can only use it after you have reached the other side of each teleport. You need {spell:Levitate} or lots of {item:Parcel|Parcels}.

In Goroma, go down the hole to the **west** again (the one with the spellbook), cross the energy barrier, go up with the rope ({item:Rope}) and head to the **south** side of the Goroma volcano. Follow the image, using {spell:Levitate} or {item:Parcel|Parcels}, to climb the volcano.
Route to climb the Goroma volcano
At the top of the volcano, go down the stairs. Follow the stairs and steps (marked in pink) to the bottom of the volcano, killing the creatures you need to.
Stairs to follow inside the volcano (pink circles)

If {wiki:Fire from the Earth Mini World Change|Fire from the Earth} is active, inside the volcano you find {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings} and {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}. Otherwise, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.
Use {spell:Invisible} or a {item:Stealth Ring}: Fire Devils and Stone Golems do not see invisible.
Crossing the cave under the mountain
Now under the mountain, follow the cave **keeping to the left** until you find a hole. Go down.

This area is full of {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. The hole leads to an undead area: {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and a {creature:Necromancer}.
Going up to the surface of Ramoa
Follow the cave to the pink circle (see the previous image) and go up with the rope. Then go **west** to another rope hole that takes you to the surface.

On the surface there are lots of {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and maybe a {creature:Giant Spider} attracted by other players.
Going down to the Teleportation Hub

Head **northeast** (green arrow in the image) until you find stairs. Go down. There are 2 teleports here: the **left** one takes you to Goroma and unlocks the return to Ramoa by teleport whenever you want. The **right** one goes to Talahu, but you cannot use it yet.
Route to the stairs of Ramoa's Teleportation Hub (green arrow)
Access to Ramoa via the Teleportation Hub

Step into the **left** teleport: you appear in the **Goroma** Teleportation Hub, underground. Go up the stairs and head **east** to {npc:Jack Fate}; say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:yes} to go back to Liberty Bay. From now on, to get to Ramoa you only need to go down to the Goroma hub and use the right teleport (the only one there).
Stairs to the Goroma Teleportation Hub
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
8. Access to Talahu (island of the Hydras)
You need 1 {item:White Mushroom}, 1 {item:Brown Mushroom}, 1 {item:Green Mushroom} and 1 {item:Dark Mushroom}.

Go to Ramoa via the {wiki:Teleportation Hub|Teleportation Hub}: in Goroma, go down the hub stairs and step into the right teleport. Enter the cave again heading **southwest**, until you reach the room with **four basins and a teleport**.
Ramoa cave: you start at the blue mark, go to the yellow mark (basin room)
Stairs to the Goroma Teleportation Hub
Place the mushrooms in the basins in this arrangement and then step into the teleport:
Mushroom order: White in the northwest, Brown in the southwest, Green in the northeast, Dark in the southeast
Every time someone steps into the teleport, the four mushrooms disappear.
The mushroom riddle is in the book {wiki:Sacrifice Notes (Book)|Sacrifice Notes}, in {wiki:Lich Hell|Lich Hell}.

You arrive in a room with a single {creature:Bog Raider}. Kill it and go up through the hole. **Do not step into the teleport**, or you go back to the mushroom room and need new mushrooms. Head **southeast** until you find a hole to go up. Go up again.

On the way there are several {creature:Quara Scout|Quara Scouts} and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}. On the surface there are several {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and a few {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}.

Go **west**, killing the monsters, and near the water you find the stairs down: this is the Teleportation Hub (there is also a {item:Mailbox} on this island). The **left** teleport takes you to Ramoa and from now on you can go to Talahu using Ramoa's right teleport. The **right** one goes to Malada, but you cannot use it yet.
Access to Talahu via the Teleportation Hub

To go back, use the **left** teleport (Ramoa) and, in Ramoa's hub, the **left** one again (Goroma). Go up the Goroma hub stairs and return to {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}) to get back to Liberty Bay.
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
9. Access to Malada (island of the Giant Spiders)
Go back to Talahu via the hub (in Goroma and then in Ramoa use the right teleport), go up to the surface, head **southeast** and follow this route.
Be ready for all types of {creature:Quara Scout|Quara Scouts}. On the surface there are several {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and a few {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}.

On the surface, head **north** to the Teleportation Hub. It only has one accessible teleport, on the **left**, which takes you to Talahu and unlocks travel to Malada by teleport whenever you want. To leave, use the **left** teleports back to Goroma (Malada → Talahu → Ramoa → Goroma) and go back to Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:passage}).
Access to Malada via the Teleportation Hub

There is no Teleportation Hub to Kharos: you always have to cross the caves, even after doing the quest. A pair of {item:Boots of Homecoming} takes you straight to the Citadel from any protection zone.

Get to Malada via the {wiki:Teleportation Hub|Teleportation Hub} (in Goroma, Ramoa and Talahu always use the right teleport) and go up the hub stairs. Head **south** across Malada until you find a trapdoor that takes you to the island's underground. The {wiki:Ferumbras Citadel|Ferumbras Citadel} is there. The trapdoor only goes down: the way out of Kharos is the teleport in the next step.

Try to **walk into the electric barrier** that blocks the Citadel (just try to step on it). Then go **east** and go down a hole to the one-way teleport that takes you back to Goroma. In Goroma, go back to Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}).
Hole with the teleport back to Goroma

Travel to **Edron** (in Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you there: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 170 gp) and talk to {npc:Zoltan}, 3 floors above ground level. Say {key:hi}, {key:Ferumbras} and {key:yes}. Listen to the story and then say {key:permission} and {key:yes} to pay **500 gp**.
The permission is only valid for **one** entry. Every time you want to enter again you have to pay 500 gp again.

Go back to Kharos: in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 170 gp); {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Goroma ({key:goroma}); use the Teleportation Hub to Malada and go down the trapdoor to the **south**. Now you can cross the barrier and enter the Citadel (once for each payment).
With a pair of {item:Boots of Homecoming} you go straight to the Citadel from any protection zone.

After you pass the barrier you cannot leave through it. To leave, go **east**, go down a hole, head **west** and go up a rope hole (you need the {item:Rope}). Then leave Kharos through the one-way teleport to Goroma (in the hole to the **east**) and go back to Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate}.
Hole with the teleport back to Goroma
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
11. Access to Nargor: earning Sabrehaven's trust
Do these 5 small missions and your reputation in Sabrehaven goes from *Suspicious* to *Friendly*.
Asking Raymond Striker for a mission
Talk to {npc:Raymond Striker}: {key:hi}, {key:mermaid} and {key:mission}. He tells you to help the villagers; ask each of them for a mission.
Talk to {npc:Ariella}: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She wants **100 {item:Bread}**. With the breads, say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Ask {npc:Ariella} for another {key:mission}. Now she wants a bottle of {item:Whisper Beer} (not ordinary beer!).
Buy the Whisper Beer in Carlin

Go to **Carlin**: from Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Edron ({key:edron}) and there {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Carlin ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}, 110 gp). The secret bar is in the sewers: enter the sewers right in front of the depot and head **south** to the underground bar. Talk to {npc:Karl}: {key:hi}, {key:whisper beer} and {key:yes} (80 gold). To leave, go back through the sewers to the entrance in front of the depot; to return, {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you to Edron ({key:edron}), {npc:Captain Seahorse} to Liberty Bay ({key:liberty bay}) and {npc:Captain Waverider} to Meriana ({key:peg leg}).
Go back to {npc:Ariella} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Talk to {npc:Morgan}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you a letter for the old sage {npc:Eremo}, on the island of Cormaya (near Edron).

From Meriana, go back to Liberty Bay with {npc:Sebastian} ({key:liberty bay}) and take {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}). In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to **Cormaya** ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}, 20 gp). At the **north harbour** of Cormaya, ask the boatman {npc:Pemaret} for passage to the hermit's island: {key:hi}, {key:eremo}, {key:yes} (free). You arrive at the small {wiki:Eremo's Island}, between Edron and Cormaya.
On the island, talk to {npc:Eremo}: {key:hi} and {key:letter}. Then go back to {npc:Morgan} and say {key:mission} to confirm.

The island has no boat back: tell {npc:Eremo} {key:hi} and {key:back} ({key:cormaya}, {key:tibia} or {key:teleport} also work) to return to **Cormaya**. There {npc:Pemaret} takes you to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 20 gp) and, in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:liberty bay}, 170 gp). Then take {npc:Captain Waverider} ({key:peg leg}) to go back to Meriana and talk to Morgan.

Talk to {npc:Duncan}, who wanders around this spot: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He wants an {item:Atlas} from the {wiki:Explorer Society|Explorer Society}, which is only sold to members of a certain rank (or ask a high-ranking member to buy it for you). With the Atlas, say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.

Talk to {npc:Chondur}, in the northeast of the island: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He wants 5 {item:Pirate Voodoo Doll|Pirate Voodoo Dolls} (easy loot in the Goroma volcano). Hand them over one by one: say {key:mission} and {key:yes} **five times**.
You can do this mission at the same time as Ray's Mission 2 (sabotage) to save time and travel money, or as soon as you have *Friendly* reputation to get direct access to Nargor.

Talk to {npc:Duncan}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants you to rescue a {item:Tortoise Egg from Nargor|tortoise egg} from the pirate base in Nargor and asks {npc:Sebastian} to take you there.
Going to the nest in Nargor

Ask {npc:Sebastian}, to the **south** of Sabrehaven, to take you to **Nargor** ({key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes}, 50 gp) and follow this map. Go down and pass the door, kill the {creature:Thornback Tortoise} and open the {item:Tortoise's Nest} to take the {item:Tortoise Egg from Nargor}.
Route to the tortoise nest in Nargor
On the way there are {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}, {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats} and {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}.

Go back the same way to where you disembarked and talk to {npc:Sebastian} in Nargor: {key:hi}, {key:meriana} and {key:yes} (50 gp) to return to Sabrehaven, or {key:liberty bay} (100 gp) to go straight to Liberty Bay.
Go back to {npc:Duncan} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. There is no direct reward, but it fulfils 1 of 2 conditions of the **Animal Activist** achievement.
1 of 2 conditions of the Animal Activist achievement

Talk to {npc:Raymond Striker} and say {key:mission}. The pirates are buying a dangerous substance, *Fafnar's Fire*, from the alchemist {npc:Sandra} in Edron. You have to pass yourself off as the pirates' envoy.

Go to **Edron** ({npc:Sebastian} to Liberty Bay and {npc:Jack Fate} to Edron, {key:edron}), to {npc:Sandra}'s potion shop. Say {key:hi}, {key:Fafnar's Fire}, {key:yes} and {key:Your continued existence is payment enough}. She gets furious and cuts her dealings with the pirates.
In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 170 gp) and there {npc:Captain Waverider} takes you to Meriana ({key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}).
Go back to {npc:Raymond Striker} and say {key:mission}.
By accepting this mission you gain access to Nargor, if you did not already have it from Duncan's mission.

Tell {npc:Raymond Striker} {key:mission}. You have to sabotage the most dangerous catapult in Nargor, at the harbour, with a {item:Fire Bug} (bought in Liberty Bay), used on the **left part** of the catapult, where the lever is.
Buy a {item:Fire Bug} in Liberty Bay and ask {npc:Sebastian} in Meriana to take you to Nargor ({key:hi}, {key:Nargor}, {key:yes}). He drops you at the secret entrance of the Howling Grotto.
Cross the Nargor caves to the harbour following the map.
Route through the Nargor caves to the catapult
You will meet {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}, {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats} and {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}.

Use the {item:Fire Bug} on the **top left corner** of the catapult. If you see a small explosion, it worked. Then go back through the caves to {npc:Sebastian} in Nargor and say {key:hi}, {key:meriana}, {key:yes} to return to Sabrehaven.
The same Fire Bug can be used more than once.
Go back to {npc:Raymond Striker} and say {key:mission}. Your reputation in Sabrehaven becomes *Cordial*.
You need a complete Pirate Set: {item:Pirate Hat}, {item:Pirate Shirt}, {item:Pirate Knee Breeches} and {item:Pirate Boots}. In a team, one set is enough for everyone.
Tell {npc:Raymond Striker} {key:mission}. You have to enter the Nargor tavern, getting past the guard, and study **all** the plans in there.
Go back to Nargor. The tavern is inside the mountain: follow the map from the previous mission and go up the stairs marked in the bottom right corner.
Stairs to the tavern (bottom right corner)
On the first floor, use {spell:Levitate} on the wall just **east** of the stairs you came up (or use some crates you find underground).
Spot to use Levitate on the first floor
On the second floor there is a {creature:Pirate Buccaneer} and 2 or 3 {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats}; you can walk past them. On the third floor head **west** to {npc:Vulturenose}.
Route on the third floor to Vulturenose
On the floor above there are lots of pirates, including {creature:Pirate Corsair|Pirate Corsairs}.
On the third floor it helps to have some {wiki:Great Fireball Rune|GFB} runes.
{npc:Vulturenose} is right at the tavern door. **Wear the complete Pirate Set** and say {key:hi} and {key:enter}. He lets you through.

Go up the stairs to the bar. It is a big room with **3 items that look like {item:Treasure Map|Treasure Maps}**: these are the {item:Plan|Plans}. Use each one (Ctrl + click, *Use*) to study them. Then go back to Meriana: go down the same way (on the first floor, go down with {spell:Levitate} in the same spot or via the crates), cross the caves to {npc:Sebastian} in Nargor and say {key:hi}, {key:meriana}, {key:yes}.
You will probably end up surrounded by pirates. Avoid killing them: make them flee, because you will have to come back here twice more in a short time.

Tell {npc:Raymond Striker} {key:mission}. With the information from the plans, he found out that {npc:Klaus}, the owner of the Nargor tavern, put a bounty on his head. You have to go and get that mission from Klaus.

Go back to the Nargor tavern ({npc:Sebastian}: {key:nargor}; same route as before; you no longer need the Pirate Set to get in) and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Klaus}. He wants you to kill Ray and bring back his lucky pillow as proof.
Go back to Meriana (the same way and with {npc:Sebastian}: {key:meriana}) and tell {npc:Raymond Striker} {key:mission}. He gives you the {item:Raymond Striker's Lucky Pillow}.
For the last time, go to the Nargor tavern and say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Klaus}. He believes Ray is dead and throws a big party.

Go back to Sabrehaven (leave the tavern the same way and ask {npc:Sebastian} in Nargor for {key:meriana}) and tell {npc:Raymond Striker} {key:mission}. He gives you a {item:Model Ship}. Then say {key:outfit} to receive the {wiki:Pirate Outfits|Pirate Outfits}.

After this quest you can do the {wiki:Pirate Outfits Quest|Pirate Outfits Quest} for the addons and ask Raymond Striker for the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of... Quest} task: kill 3000 pirates, with one of the pirate bosses at the end.
The Ferumbras Citadel requires you to pay 500 gp to Zoltan before each entry.
